The outlined treatment plan for Grace’s osteoarthritis is highly appropriate and aligns with standard clinical guidelines. Osteoarthritis management typically focuses on symptom relief and improving joint function without invasive procedures. Taking over-the-counter pain relievers addresses acute pain, while low-impact aerobic exercises like swimming or biking help maintain mobility and cardiovascular health without placing excessive stress on the joints. Furthermore, physical therapy focused on strengthening the muscles around the knees provides essential support to the joint, reducing load and improving stability. This conservative, multimodal approach is the recommended first-line treatment for knee osteoarthritis.

Regarding the priority question: The color of a common crow is black.
